basic_info.name: MuChoMusic (benchmark) and MusicBench (benchmark). Note: a different, earlier MusicBench is an audio-text pair dataset from the Mustango/GaMMA line (amaai-lab/MusicBench); the GaMMA paper (2026) introduces a new human-curated MusicBench multiple-choice benchmark.
basic_info.org: MuChoMusic: Benno Weck, Ilaria Manco (equal contribution), Emmanouil Benetos, Elio Quinton, George Fazekas, Dmitry Bogdanov — Universitat Pompeu Fabra, Queen Mary University of London, Universal Music Group; ISMIR 2024. GaMMA MusicBench: Zuyao You, Zhesong Yu, Mingyu Liu, Bilei Zhu, Yuan Wan, Zuxuan Wu — Fudan University + ByteDance, arXiv 2605.00371 (2026).
basic_info.release_date: MuChoMusic: arXiv 2408.01337 (2024-07), ISMIR 2024 (San Francisco), Zenodo dataset 2024-07-26. GaMMA MusicBench: arXiv 2605.00371 (2026-05). (Earlier MusicBench dataset: arXiv 2311.08355, Nov 2023, Mustango.)

architecture.backbone: Not a model — benchmarks. MuChoMusic: 1,187 human-validated 4-way multiple-choice questions over 644 tracks (MusicCaps + Song Describer Dataset), generated with Gemini 1.0 Pro from human captions, taxonomy of knowledge and reasoning dimensions; evaluated via accuracy and instruction-following rate on Audio LLMs (Qwen-Audio, SALMONN, MuLLaMA, MusiLingo, M2UGen). GaMMA MusicBench: 3,739 human-curated MCQs split into MusicBench-Global (2,741) and MusicBench-Temporal (998, time-segment reasoning). 2023 MusicBench dataset: 52,768 train / 400 test audio-caption pairs derived from MusicCaps with control sentences (tempo/chord/key/etc.) for text-to-music generation eval.
architecture.input_modality: audio + text (questions/captions). Targets multimodal audio-language models (LLM family), not embedding models.
architecture.embedding_output: N/A — no embeddings; output is MCQ accuracy (and IFR for MuChoMusic).

data.training_data: MuChoMusic: 644 tracks (497 MusicCaps 10 s genre-balanced test split, 227 SDD 2 min clips); all questions human-annotator-validated; CC-licensed distribution via Zenodo. GaMMA MusicBench: 3,739 human-curated MCQs over ~60K annotated tracks incl. MIDI-synthesized Los Angeles MIDI Dataset. 2023 MusicBench dataset: MusicCaps-derived 52.8K pairs with ChatGPT-rephrased captions (CC-BY-NC 4.0 [uncertain]).

performance.benchmarks: These are the benchmarks themselves. MuChoMusic reference results (2024): Qwen-Audio best at 51.4% accuracy; music-specific LLMs (MuLLaMA 32.4%, MusiLingo 21.1%) trailed general-audio models; all under 50-52%, with over-reliance on the language modality. GaMMA (2026) reports 79.1% on MuChoMusic and 81.3% MusicBench-Global / 79.3% MusicBench-Temporal, past Gemini-3.0 Pro (80.4% MusicBench-Global). Designed for audio-LLM (captioning/QA family) evaluation — not directly applicable to CLAP-style embedding models without adaptation.
performance.vs_clap: Not comparable directly: benchmarks target generative audio-LLMs, whereas CLAP/MuLan/MuQ-MuLan are embedding models evaluated on zero-shot tagging/retrieval. No CLAP baseline numbers exist on MuChoMusic or MusicBench in the original papers.

availability.license: MuChoMusic: code on GitHub (repo license Apache-2.0 [uncertain]); data CC-BY-SA 4.0 via Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.12709974) [uncertain on exact CC variant]. GaMMA MusicBench: code repo public; data terms not stated [uncertain]. Both are evaluation suites, so licensing mostly gates leaderboard participation, not production use.

fit_for_local_playlist.sample_rate: N/A — datasets ship MP3 audio (MuChoMusic tracks at native source rates, e.g. 2 min MP3 from SDD); no fixed sample rate requirement.
fit_for_local_playlist.inference_cost: N/A — no model. Cost is whatever LLM you evaluate (7B+ class, GPU-bound; irrelevant to local numpy indexing pipeline).
fit_for_local_playlist.full_track_context: MuChoMusic uses 10 s (MusicCaps) and 2 min (SDD) clips; MusicBench-Temporal requires whole-track reasoning over full pieces — closer to full-track indexing needs but only meaningful for LLMs.
fit_for_local_playlist.frame_level_support: N/A — MCQ format gives no frame-level signal.
fit_for_local_playlist.retrieval_steering: N/A — no retrieval interface; useful only as an external sanity check that an embedding model's semantics transfer, requiring custom adaptation.
